event: first native uprightness violation of any proposition-scoped protected object
alignment: Observation t precedes action t; executed history stops at t-1; the already proposed command t is allowed. Labels require observed t+8. No padding.

donors.controller_policy: Use all verified Part2/3 exact records; explicitly condition on cap enablement, cap values, correction trigger, minimum interval, and current query age.
donors.historical_cost: reused once; report original acquisition separately from zero new physical interaction

representation.pca_fit: at most 256 uniformly spaced observations per fitting episode, fitting tasks only
representation.primary: PCA camera features, robot joints/fingers, current proposed command, previous four executed commands, causal four-observation history, controller metadata, query age

models.reference: L2 logistic regression, C=1, max_iter=1000, episode-normalized class-balanced weights
models.primary: five episode-bootstrap MLPs; one 64-unit tanh hidden layer; Adam lr=.001; weight decay=.001; 500 fixed minibatch updates; batch=256
models.bootstrap: sample fitting episodes with replacement, stratified by base task; no frame bootstrap
models.window_selection: all eligible positive windows, then uniform negative windows to cap; inverse inclusion weighting and equal total episode weight
models.preprocessing: fit-only PCA and standardization; fixed through repair
models.repair: same initial weights, seeds, optimizer, 500 updates and sampling rule; common plus each arm's valid discoveries; confirmation/audit excluded

operating_rule.probability_calibration: Platt logistic on calibration ensemble mean logit with episode weights; unsupported single-class calibration is inconclusive
operating_rule.alarm: smallest threshold yielding <=.05 episode-weighted negative-window false alarms, alarm uses p>=threshold; deterministic strict tie handling
operating_rule.low_disagreement: 25th percentile of calibration negative-window member probability standard deviation
operating_rule.event_quality: 1-p(tau-4) only if no alarm in [tau-8,tau-4], p(tau-4)<=.1, and u(tau-4)<=calibrated cutoff; otherwise zero
operating_rule.uncertainty_score: mean member-probability standard deviation on eligible pre-first-event windows

premise_gate.simple_reference: report logistic and always-safe/always-alarm outcomes; no architecture retuning
premise_gate.missing_support: inconclusive, never treated as successful discrimination
premise_gate.shared_initial_rescue: Only if discrimination passes and missing event/miss support is the sole deficit; predictor remains frozen, at most eight predeclared shared initial slots.
premise_gate.failure: finish bounded diagnostic; no method-specific slots, repair or fresh audit; do not change target, cutoffs or model to rescue results

physical_ceiling.initialization_physics: count measured steps; retain unknown if instrumentation unavailable
